entities.summary: Dean Frederic William Farrar was a senior-ranking cleric of the Church of England, philologist, author and schoolteacher. He was a pallbearer at the funeral of Charles Darwin in 1882. He was a member of the Cambridge Apostles secret society. He was the Archdeacon of Westminster from 1883 to 1894, and Dean of Canterbury from 1895 until his death in 1903.
